caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical stoneware jar with two small, rounded handles on either side near the top. The jar is colored in light beige and brownish tones, with a glossy finish that reflects light, particularly around the rim. At the upper front of the jar, the inscription “J. & E. NORTON, BENNINGTON VT, 3” is embossed and visible. Below the inscription, a large decorative blue image of a bird is painted on the surface. The bird is perched on a branch with its tail feathers extended downward and its head turned to the left. The blue motif includes curves and lines that form the bird’s body, feathers, and the branch, with additional blue accents and dots near the lower part of the branch. The background is a plain, off-white color without any additional objects or elements. The artist's name, “John Barantino,” is written in small, neat letters at the lower right corner of the image.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
